method: Original procedural, periodic C2 value noise and analytic patterns; no photo projection, baked illumination, or external source images.
tiling: All source fields are periodic in U and V; use repeat extension. Adjacent edge pixels need not be identical because samples are pixel centers on a periodic domain.

asphalt.description: Dark charcoal warm asphalt with millimetric fine aggregate; no road paint.

concrete.description: Weathered warm-gray concrete; subtle periodic lower-panel stain and fine pores.
concrete.mapping_note: V vertical on retaining walls. Stain is periodic and intentionally subdued.

sidewalk.description: Staggered dusty pink/gray rectangular paving with subdued warm-gray joints.

cliff.description: Dark warm soil/rock with fine irregular sedimentary bands and weathered mineral grain.
cliff.mapping_note: V vertical along cliff; larger silhouette variation should come from geometry.

grass.description: Patchy coastal olive-green ground cover, restrained dry brown patches and fine grass/straw.
grass.mapping_note: Ground-cover material; individual tall vegetation should be modeled separately.

palm_bark.description: Warm gray-brown fibrous palm trunk with periodic, irregular horizontal leaf-scar ridges.
palm_bark.mapping_note: U wraps trunk circumference, V along trunk. Taper belongs to geometry.

palm_leaf.description: Natural coastal palm green with slender longitudinal veins and subdued waxy roughness.
palm_leaf.mapping_note: U across the leaflet width; V along its length. Geometry supplies outline; no alpha mask.

asphalt_damp_roughness.png.method: Original asphalt roughness multiplied by 0.43 to support low-sun damp sheen.

water_normal.png.method: Seamless random-phase sum of 70 sinusoidal wave modes; original procedural spectrum.
